text.card: Kepler-22 is a 5,596 K star 195 parsecs away with 1 known transiting planet.
text.introduction: Kepler-22 is a star of 5,596 K 195 parsecs away. Its planet Kepler-22 b crosses it, which is how it was found and sized.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (st_refname BONOMO_ET_AL_2023): st_teff 5596, st_rad 0.869, st_mass 0.857

quotes.title: Kepler-22
quotes.card: Kepler-22 is a Sun-like star in the northern constellation of Cygnus, the swan, that is orbited by a planet found to be unequivocally within the star's habitable zone.
quotes.introduction: It is located at the celestial coordinates: Right Ascension 19h 16m 52.2s, Declination +47° 53′ 3.9″.
